verdict.rationale: Abacum's own pages claim directly that finance can update the plan without rebuilding it, with actuals, assumptions and forecasts connected in one workspace (docs-6). They also describe budgeting and forecasting in one model with live actuals (docs-15) and live ERP actuals feeding the model so numbers are today's rather than last close's (docs-7, docs-9). These are marketing-level claims only. missing for 10: documented mechanics of the post-close re-baseline (e.g. actuals replacing forecast periods or rolling-forecast handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.
